blocks.text: Reactants ya products ki concentration mein tabdeeli physical aur chemical dono methods (tareeqon) se maloom ki ja sakti hai; tareeqa is par depend karta hai ke reactants ya products kis qism ke hain.

Yeh tareeqa khaas taur par solution mein hone wali reactions ke liye suitable (theek) hai. Is mein kisi reactant ya product ka chemical analysis (jaanch) kiya jata hai. Thore se acid ki presence (maujoodgi) mein ester (ethyl acetate) ka acid hydrolysis is ki behtareen misal hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein ester ka formula CH₃COO₂H₅ chhapa hai; is mein ek carbon reh gaya hai. Ethyl acetate ka sahi formula CH₃COOC₂H₅ hai.

Pani mein ester ka solution aur catalyst ka kaam karne wala acid react karne diye jate hain. Kuch der baad pipette se mixture ka thora sa sample nikal kar apne volume se taqreeban chaar guna barf jaise thande pani mein dala jata hai. Dilution (pani mila kar halka karna) aur thanda hone se reaction ruk jati hai. Phir bane hue acid ko standard alkali (maslan NaOH) se titrate kiya jata hai; indicator phenolphthalein hota hai.
Yeh jaanch reaction shuru hone ke baad different times (alag alag waqt) par repeat ki jati hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke waqt ke saath acetic acid ki concentration kaise badal rahi hai.
Concentration napne ke kuch physical tareeqe yeh hain:

Yeh tareeqa tab kaam aata hai jab koi reactant ya product ultraviolet, visible ya infrared radiation absorb (jazb) kare. Kitni radiation absorb hui, yeh naap kar rate maloom hoti hai. Figure 7.3 wali reaction mein concentration colorimetry se napi ja sakti hai.

blocks.alt: Safaid stand (rack) mein chhe test tubes. Un ke solutions pehli tube mein dark red-brown se orange ho kar aakhri tube mein taqreeban colourless (be-rang) ho jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.3: Is reaction ki concentration ki tabdeeli colorimetry se maloom ki ja sakti hai (kitab ki Figure 7.3 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tubes mein rang waqt ke saath halka hota ja raha hai, yani rangdar cheez kam ho rahi hai. Colorimeter rang ki gehrai naap kar concentration bata deta hai.

Jis reaction mein ions hon, us ki rate electrical conductivity (bijli guzarne ki salahiyat) se napi ja sakti hai. Aise solution ki conductivity react karne wale ya bante hue ions ki concentration ke badalne par depend karti hai, aur un ions ki concentration ki tabdeeli ki rate ke proportional (barabar nisbat se) hoti hai.

Yeh tareeqa un reactions ke liye hai jin mein gas ka volume badalta hai, jaise Figure 7.4 mein. Volume ki tabdeeli reaction kitni aage barhi aur concentration kitni badli, is ke seedha proportional hai.

blocks.alt: Stopper se band conical flask; stopper se delivery tube oopar aur phir aage horizontal (leti hui) gas syringe tak jati hai. Syringe ka barrel stand par clamp se thama hai aur plunger daen taraf bahar nikla hai. Labels: conical flask, delivery tube, gas syringe, clamp, stand.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.4: Reaction mein nikalne wali gas ke volume ki tabdeeli naap kar reaction ki rate dekhi ja sakti hai (kitab ki Figure 7.4 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Flask mein reaction se gas nikalti hai, delivery tube se syringe mein jati hai aur plunger ko bahar dhakelti hai. Har kuch seconds baad syringe par gas ka volume parhein: volume jitni tezi se barhe, reaction utni tez hai.

blocks.title: Interesting Information (dilchasp maloomat)
blocks.text: Bohat tez reactions ki rate stopped-flow spectrophotometry se dekhi ja sakti hai. Is mein reactants ke bohat chhote volumes tezi se ek mixing chamber mein dhakele jate hain. Wahan se yeh observation cell mein jate hain jahan reaction ki progress dekhi jati hai (aam taur par sample mein se ultraviolet radiation ka transmission (guzarna) naap kar). Rate ka time ke saath graph automatically (khud ba khud) ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: In mein se har ek ki rate napne ke liye aap kaun sa tareeqa chunenge: marble ke tukre hydrochloric acid se; bromine water alkene se react kar ke rang khoti hui; aisi reaction jo neutral molecules se ions banati hai?
blocks.explanation: Marble aur acid se carbon dioxide gas nikalti hai, to gas ka volume naapein (volume change). Bromine water rangdar hai, us ka rang halka hona colorimetry se naapein. Ions banane wali reaction mein solution ki conductivity barhti hai, to electrical conductivity ka tareeqa istemal karein.

items: Chemical method: sample nikalein, thande pani se reaction rokein, titrate karein (ester hydrolysis: acid ko NaOH aur phenolphthalein se).
Physical methods: colorimetry (absorb hone wali radiation), electrical conductivity (ions), volume change (gases); bohat tez reactions ke liye stopped-flow spectrophotometry.
